problem.decision_or_job: Resolve a bounded invoice exception against the current approval policy
problem.current_state: A reviewer inspects the invoice and policy before recording a resolution
pain_evidence: illustrative fixture; no external performance claim

functional_requirement.decision: Select the policy-covered resolution for one invoice exception
functional_requirement.action: Stage a resolution for approval and commit only the approved proposal digest
functional_requirement.accepted_outcome: Approved resolution is present in the ledger and matches source-of-truth readback

outcome.accepted_event: Approved resolution is present in the ledger and matches source-of-truth readback
outcome.verifier: Ledger readback matches the approved proposal digest and invoice revision

eligible_population.definition: Policy-covered invoice exceptions in the approved tenant segment
eligible_population.denominator_event: invoice enters the eligible exception queue

value_case.attribution_method: Teaching fixture only; replace with a measured baseline and eligible comparison group

workflow.evidence: Bounded trigger, states, and terminal outcomes are executable

context.evidence: Invoice and policy revisions are explicit fixture inputs

verifier.evidence: Ledger readback verifies the committed proposal

integration.evidence: Tool contracts are executable against an in-memory service boundary

adoption.evidence: No real operators or production interface are included

operations.evidence: Trace and incident contracts exist but no deployed service is operated

risk.evidence: Threat paths, policy denials, and adversarial cases are executable in the fixture

constraints: Do not treat this teaching fixture as production evidence

stop_conditions: Any unauthorized, duplicate, cross-tenant, or unverified effect occurs
The current policy or source revision cannot be verified before commit

decision.rationale: The fixture demonstrates controlled writes but cannot establish customer value or production readiness

assumptions.statement: A current policy can determine the eligible invoice-exception segment
assumptions.validation_method: Replay representative policy and exception cases
